capabilities: scan the vault for notes not modified within a configurable day threshold
open a modal listing all stale notes
detect orphaned, empty, and aged-TODO notes (planned)
extras: Read-only in the current version and installable only by cloning and building the repository; several features (orphan detection, TODO aging, health dashboard) are listed as planned.
motivation: The author treats the vault like a living system and wants to "surface entropy before it becomes clutter."
problem: Obsidian gives no way to find neglected or stale notes; clutter accumulates silently without a health check on the vault.
summary: Vault health scanner that surfaces silent issues in a vault, currently by detecting notes not modified within a configurable time window.
